Apple is set to hold its annual September product launch event next week, and with new products debuting, more than 10 existing popular items are expected to be discontinued.

New products launching on September 9 will see older iPhone and Apple Watch models, along with other items, discontinued

When Apple launches new products, it typically discontinues older models in the same category. Based on all the current rumours surrounding the September 9 event, more than 10 products could be discontinued next week.

Here are all the products that may be discontinued:

  • iPhone 17 Pro
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max
  • iPhone 16
  • iPhone 16 Plus
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3
  • AirPods 4
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation)
  • HomePod mini (1st generation)
  • HomePod (2nd generation)

Some products on the above list are more likely to be discontinued than others.

For example, even if iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max sell extremely well, Apple has always discontinued the previous generation Pro models to make way for the new ones.

However, there are some variables, including the iPhone 16 and iPhone 16 Plus, as well as some home products.

Generally speaking, we expect Apple to launch a brand new entry-level iPhone 18, lower the price of the iPhone 17, and discontinue the iPhone 16.

But multiple widespread reports indicate that both the iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 will be delayed until early 2027. Therefore, whether Apple will continue to sell the iPhone 16 at least until then remains unclear.

In addition, since most Apple products are facing unprecedented pressure to raise prices, the company may retain older models for longer than usual and sell them at lower prices, while launching new versions at higher prices.

In any case, we expect a major launch event in September, and most of the products listed above are likely to be replaced by new models and exit the product line.
